name: MOMAH Map Services API
description:
API specification for the MOMRAH Map GL services, vector tiles, and static assets used by the Ministry of Municipal Rural Affairs and Housing (Saudi Arabia).
This schema covers the JS API entry point, style configurations, vector tile requests, and static style resources.
